sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionCategory,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS DiscountedRevenue,
    avg(p.DiscountPercent) AS AvgDiscountPercent
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE f.PromotionKey != 1
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY DiscountedRevenue DESC
